staging.about: M1-84 (doc 24 §5 optional moment CH01-MUGS-NAMED, M3-99 PR_Mug_Named): at the end of EX-CH01-S12 the four nameless mugs of EX-CH01-S01 gain masking tape and the cadets' names, and keep them for the rest of the game (the CH04-S12 echo; CS-17's five named mugs). The layer shows once the moment is in story_log.moments (CampaignRoom.set_story_choices(choices, moments)); each mug stands where it stood, its name facing the commons. Front row from the commons side, west to east: KAI, AMARA; back row: MEI, RAFI (role order, as the CH07-S01 observation cards). Ferreira's fifth mug is not part of this moment. In EX-CH02-S11..S12 Amara's mug is the cup set down by the pending-reply indicator (M3-2R): it moves 3 cm toward the indicator and rattles in S12; ch02_reply_cup stands in for it while the mugs are nameless.

From 12 Dec 2046 Ferreira lives at Aurora: four seats become five (doc 09 LOC-01) and the fifth mug joins the four (doc 24 §1.1). Until she lands the mug hangs on its clip above the table (ch05_fifth_mug_clip, CH04-S12 to EX-CH05-S01, which plays at the garage dock, LOC-08); it stands at her place from S02; she takes it to the corridor watch in S06 and places it beside the four in S11 (canon, M3-5R). Her chair is at the head of the table until she gives it up in EX-CH07-S01 (doc 24 §2.7); from EX-CH07-S02 it stands among the cadets' chairs on the east side (M3-7R). CH08 (M3-8R): while Ferreira is on the road (8-10 Apr) her mug waits on the care desk beside the home-night ledger; from EX-CH08-S11 it is back beside the others (doc 24 2.9 S11 -> S12).

DEPARTS EARTH 8 DEC 2046  ·  ARRIVES AURORA 12 DEC 2046
COMMANDER FERREIRA TRAVELS WITH THE PLANNED RELIEF;
HER EARTH DUTIES PAUSE FOR THE FLIGHT
RAO STAYS AT THE EARTH DESK

FERREIRA, BEFORE TRAVEL:  “{line}”

RELIEF CARGO, ARRIVING 12 DEC
RELAY CONTROLLER SPARE: 1, SEALED CRATE
QUARANTINE SUPPLIES
ROUTINE HABITAT SUPPLIES
CHECKED AGAINST THE LIST
GARDEN AND VAULT: CARE PLAN UNCHANGED

22 OCT TO 12 DEC  -  THE DAYS IN BETWEEN
23 OCT  TWELVE-SPECIMEN REPORT SENT; RAO'S RECEIPT
NOVEMBER  GARDEN AND VAULT CARE ON SCHEDULE
NOVEMBER  THE SPARE MUG POLISHED, ONCE
1 DEC  FIFTH LOCKER LABELLED
8 DEC  DEPARTURE NOTICE ON THE EARTH SCREEN
12 DEC  THE LANDING CAMERA

FIFTH OCCUPANT, ARRIVING 12 DEC
LOCKER: THIS ONE, NAMED 1 DEC
SEAT AT THE TABLE: READY
ARRIVAL: GARAGE DOCK, CARGO HELD IN THE DRY LOCK
EARTH SUPPORT DURING THE FLIGHT: RAO

staging.about: Doc 24 2.9 CH04-S12 montage, 1 Dec 2046: the fifth locker in the Commons crew locker bank is labelled for Commander Ferreira before she lands, and keeps her name from then on.

signs.text: FERREIRA

staging.about: While the rover is out (8-10 Apr) Aurora's copy of the home-night ledger lies on the care desk: two here for the first 33 h, five for the last 3 h (canon S05; the S01 duplicate checklist went with Kai; M3-105 moved the CH07-S12 departure set, with its ledger, to the garage).

signs.text:
HOME-NIGHT LEDGER, AURORA COPY
2 PEOPLE FOR THE FIRST 33 H
5 PEOPLE FOR THE LAST 3 H BEFORE DAWN

staging.about: EX-CH08-S06 at Aurora (8 Apr 18:00 to 9 Apr 00:00): the main display carries the local radio through the three road repeaters: the new summit packet (sender, position, time) above the earlier approach packet it must not be mistaken for, and the home checks done first, with the small guide light on where it was planned (S05 -> S06). The Earth uplink is still down. The home-night ledger lies on the care desk.

signs.text:
LOCAL RADIO   THREE ROAD REPEATERS, FOUR HOPS

NEW   RAFI   MALAPERT SUMMIT PAD   9 APR 2047, 00:00   THREE ABOARD
OLD   RAFI   100 KM APPROACH   8 APR, 17:00

HOME CHECKS FIRST: AIR, TEMPERATURE, RETURN PATH OPEN
SMALL GUIDE LIGHT: ON, WHERE PLANNED
EARTH UPLINK: STILL DOWN

staging.about: EX-CH08-S10 at Aurora's table (9 Apr 02:15-03:00): the Earth link is live through the Malapert relay; Rao, then Noor, on the Commons Earth screen (drawn by CampaignCrew, M4-06), the voice checks and telemetry on the care desk, and the invitation Mei sent in December open on her tablet at her place (doc 24 5.2 D10).
Doc 24 5.2 D10: the invitation Mei sent is open on her screen when Noor speaks.

signs.text:

WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE WHAT GROWS NEXT?

staging.about: Doc 24 5.2 D10: the invitation Mei sent is open on her screen when Noor speaks; the N. holder waits beside it.

WE KEPT A PLACE FOR YOUR WORK.
